description: Fetch a post together with its direct replies. One level deep, not a recursive tree: Antiphony's thread model is a prompt and the replies answering it, so a nested view would describe a structure the data does not have.

main.description: Returns the parent post and a cursor-paginated page of its direct replies, oldest first. A missing parent is an error rather than an empty page, so a caller can tell 'no replies yet' from 'no such post'.

id.description: Record key of the parent post.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor — the `cursor` from the previous page.

replies.description: Direct replies, in thread order (oldest first).

cursor.description: Cursor for the next page. Absent or null on the last page — set only when this page was full.

errors.name: RecordNotFound
errors.description: No parent post with this key in the caller's tenancy.
